description: Accounts written in a mixture of Judaeo-Arabic and Arabic script. Dated in the upper left corner of the verso: סנת לז׳ ותתק׳, which is possibly the year 1937 Seleucid (1625/1626 CE). This dating seems feasible based on the paleography but the scribe may have intended these digits as gematria instead (30+7+6+400+400+100= 933 AH). The latter option also seems feasible as a Hijrī year in the sixteenth century (1526/27 CE). Requires further examination.
description_he: לכאורה חשבונות כתובים בתערובת של יהודית-ערבית וכתב ערבי; מאוחר
